Lets Anti Theft block a thief from uninstalling it, and lock the phone remotely. You can turn this off anytime from here or in Settings → Security → Device admin apps.

Shizuku lets this app turn on mobile data & location without root.

Galaxy S23 Ultra (One UI 6):
1. Install Shizuku from the Play Store.
2. Settings → About phone → Software information → tap Build number 7× to unlock Developer options.
3. Developer options → turn on Wireless debugging.
4. In Shizuku, tap “Start via Wireless debugging” and follow the pairing.
5. If pairing is blocked, turn off Settings → Security and privacy → Auto Blocker, then retry.

With a PC over USB:
1. Enable USB debugging, connect the cable.
2. Run: adb shell sh /sdcard/Android/data/moe.shizuku.privileged.api/start.sh

After it’s running, come back and tap “Request access”.
Note: Shizuku must be restarted after every reboot.
